script_text: Mars, your ruling planet, is igniting a cosmic firestorm this week that will shake your foundations. On Monday, Mars forms a tense square with Saturn in your 10th House of Career, creating obstacles that test your patience. By Tuesday, the Sun trines Jupiter in your 2nd House of Money, opening totally unexpected financial opportunities. Wednesday brings Mercury conjunct Venus in your 7th House of Relationships, transforming communication with partners. Thursday through Sunday, the Moon moves through fire signs, amplifying your natural boldness. The weekend shines as Mars enters your 1st House of Self, renewing confidence to pursue what you want. Wednesday is your power day because Venus enters your 5th House of Love, sparking romantic connections. Avoid major decisions Monday when Mars squares Saturn in your career sector. Trust your instinct mid-week, but verify details before committing to any new path. Follow for daily updates.
